title: The Space CRM People page opens a door to Conversations

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-12 email pilot: could not find New conversation from the People page

detail: Found 2026-10-12 while the owner ran the Space email pilot. /spaces/<slug>/crm/conversations (the ticketed inbox with the New conversation compose, ADR-812) is reachable only from the Space dashboard's Resonance module and from a Needs attention banner that renders only while a thread is unanswered. The People board at /spaces/<slug>/crm, where a manager actually goes to reach a contact, has no link, tab or button to it, so the owner typed the URL by hand. Add one door on the People board (a view tab next to Pipeline and Cockpit in components/spaces/crm/crm-view-tabs.tsx, or a heading action) that links to the Conversations console for a manager of a console Space. Same door on the platform /admin/crm board if it has the same gap. No new page, no new system.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/crm\/conversations/.test(r('components/spaces/crm/crm-view-tabs.tsx')+r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/crm-body.tsx')+r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/page.tsx'))){console.error('LIVE-897: the Space CRM People page has no door to Conversations');process.exit(1)}"
